newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Dozens of Israeli soldiers dead in helicopter crash.
newsitem.headline: Dozens of Israeli soldiers dead in helicopter crash.

text.p: Dozens of Israeli soldiers were killed in a collision on Tuesday between two military helicopters in stormy weather near the border with Lebanon, security sources said.

The army said the helicopters crashed in northern Israel. Witnesses said rescue workers evacuated dozens of bodies on stretchers after the crash. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu cancelled a trip to Jordan planned for Wednesday.
